title: Concept: WebView JavaScript bridge (java)
description: In java, addJavascriptInterface gives web content a path into native Java objects. Untrusted page content can call every exposed method. The remedy is a @JavascriptInterface allowlist on first-party pages.
applicability: Android apps using WebView; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Native method invocation from attacker-controlled web content on older Android versions; HIGH severity.
